relationship_description: Antonio Floirendo Jr. is the son of Antonio Floirendo Sr., founder of the Floirendo political and business dynasty in Davao del Norte.
Antonio Floirendo Jr. is the uncle of Antonio Lagdameo Jr., both prominent members of the Floirendo-Lagdameo dynasty in Davao del Norte.
Antonio Miro III is the son of Antonio Miro Jr., both of whom have held political office in Bataan.
